name: ProbabilityTheory.cond
type: {Ω : Type u} → {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} → MeasureTheory.Measure Ω → Set Ω → MeasureTheory.Measure Ω
provides: The measure restricted to an event and divided by its mass; it is a probability law for positive finite event mass and is zero for null or infinite-mass events.

name: ProbabilityTheory.variance_of_integral_eq_zero
type: {Ω : Type u} → {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} → {X : Ω → ℝ} → {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} → MeasureTheory.AEMeasurable X μ → (MeasureTheory.integral μ X = 0) → ProbabilityTheory.variance X μ = MeasureTheory.integral μ (fun ω => X ω ^ 2)
provides: Identifies real variance with the raw second-moment integral for an almost-everywhere measurable, mean-zero real function; finiteness remains necessary for a statistical variance interpretation.
